title: Valid weighted graph
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices, with weight $w(v,u)$ for each ordered pair of vertices. The graph is valid if all weights are nonnegative, the weights are symmetric in their two vertices, their sum over all ordered pairs is $1$, and every self-loop has weight $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a weighted directed graph on the vertex set of size $n$
